title: Reward Certificate Terms Schedule — Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus
content:
Reward certificates of **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** are bought with points. This schedule fixes, per tier, how many points one certificate takes, what it is worth, how long it lasts and how it may be used.

## Conversion and validity

| Tier | Points per certificate | Certificate value | Issued automatically when the balance reaches the conversion figure | Usable for (calendar days from issue) | Certificates usable on one order or checkout |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pals Rewards Member | 1000 | $5.00 | Yes | 30 | 2 |
| Pals Rewards Insider | 1000 | $5.00 | Yes | 30 | 2 |
| Pals Rewards VIP | 1000 | $5.00 | Yes | 45 | 3 |
| Tailwise Plus Monthly | 1000 | $5.00 | Yes | 45 | 3 |
| Tailwise Plus Annual | 1000 | $5.00 | Yes | 45 | 3 |
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | 1000 | $5.00 | Yes | 60 | 5 |

## Use and reissue

| Tier | Courtesy reissue of an expired, unused certificate | Courtesy reissue window after expiry | Reissue of a certificate used on a returned order |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pals Rewards Member | No | 0 calendar days | Yes |
| Pals Rewards Insider | No | 0 calendar days | Yes |
| Pals Rewards VIP | Yes | 30 calendar days | Yes |
| Tailwise Plus Monthly | Yes | 30 calendar days | Yes |
| Tailwise Plus Annual | Yes | 30 calendar days | Yes |
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | Yes | 30 calendar days | Yes |

## Settings common to every tier

- Certificates cannot be used on pharmacy (Rx) purchases, gift cards, live pets or membership fees.
- An unused remainder of a certificate does not stay usable (partial use is not allowed).
- Certificates combine with promotional coupons.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A Pals Rewards VIP member with three certificates may use all three on one order, worth $15.00 together; a Pals Rewards Member could use only two of them on that order.
